answer_1.quote: We empirically test EPR on three structured sequence-to-sequence tasks, where input natural language utterances are mapped to a meaning representation: MTOP and SM-CALFLOW, which focus on task-oriented dialogue, and BREAK, a benchmark for mapping questions to a language-based meaning representation.

answer_2.quote: On BREAK, we evaluate performance on the development set with LF-EM... On the test set, we use NEM. On MTOP and SM-CALFLOW, we evaluate with Exact Match (EM), i.e., whether the string output by the inference LM is identical to the reference string.
